source.name: PR Newswire / SailGP - ROCKWOOL renews multi-year commitment to SailGP to 2032, marking league's longest-standing team partnership
source.quote: ROCKWOOL has renewed its multi-year commitment to SailGP, extending its title partnership of the Danish-flagged ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team through to the end of 2032.

note: Title partnership running since 2019, renewed 27 November 2025 through the end of 2032. Since February 2026 the team is owned and operated by American Magic (Doug DeVos), with ROCKWOOL continuing as Title Partner (americanmagic.com, 2026-02-12: https://www.americanmagic.com/en/news/219_American-Magic-Acquires-Danish-ROCKWOOL-Racing-SailGP-Team-in-Landmark-Deal.html). No deal value reported.
